thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT — service: inference-hosted | region: eu-west-2 | symptom: elevated 5xxs and latency spikes on gpu-pool-alpha. Auto-fallback engaged to cpu-fallback-1. Triggered at 1845012345.
Aisha Patel: Saw the page, joining bridge. Any customer-facing hit numbers yet?
Samir Rao: On bridge. Initial probe: GPU pods in gpu-pool-alpha are being preempted by cluster scheduler, autoscaler reacted but oscillated. Roughly 12% errors for p99 requests in the last 6m.
Priya Desai: @Samir can you share the node preemption logs? I want to see whether it's spot eviction or kernel OOM.
Samir Rao: pasted logs -> ```syslog: evicting pod/pool-alpha-3 due to preemption; Kubelet: NodeTerminated: spot-terminate signal;``` looks like provider-side preemptions.
Eli Nguyen: Confirming autoscaler hit a cooldown loop. Scale up request spiked, then some pods failed during init (model load timeout), then scale down—oscillation.
Nina Gomez: Customer impact: we saw an uptick in 5xx from 11 customers using high-concurrency endpoints. Top affected customers flagged via alerts.
Maya Cohen: Ops note: auto-fallback to cpu-fallback-1 preserved throughput for lower-priority routes but increased token cost and latency. We should track billing exposure. :money_with_wings:
ops-bot: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-preemption — steps executed: isolate pool, enable conservative autoscale, divert traffic to us-west-2, trigger model-variant fallback.
Aisha Patel: Handoff plan: @Samir you continue mitigation for next 30m, then @Priya will take primary for root-cause and postmortem. I'll own customer comms and postmortem scheduling.
Samir Rao: Ack. Current mitigations applied: set autoscaler.minReplicas=4 for gpu-pool-alpha, reduced maxBurst to 10, added 30s startupTimeout to avoid thrashing on model load.
Priya Desai: Adding note — we'll also try pinning instances to non-preemptible for a canary subset. Initiating instanceMigration job (canary=2).
Eli Nguyen: Telemetry checks I ran: GPU allocation dropped from 92%->54% across region, queue length spiked to 480 at peak, KV cache hit-rate unchanged (so not cache related).
Nina Gomez: Customer impact detail: error spike window ~11:08–11:24 UTC, estimated affected token fraction ~2.4% of total hosted traffic. Key customers: partner-A, partner-C.
Maya Cohen: Quick mitigation suggestion: enable regional failover for critical routes to us-west-2 for 1 hour. We already started this for high-risk customers.
Samir Rao: Handoff marker: 1845012600 — passing primary to Priya. I will stay reachable for context.
Priya Desai: Thanks. Immediate next steps I will own: 1) Confirm whether preemptions are provider spot evictions vs internal scheduler churn. 2) Validate autoscaler config and add hysteresis. 3) Run controlled canary with fixed instances.
incident-bot: REMINDER — create incident ticket and mark severity: sev2. Templates: https://redwood.internal/incidents/template-gpu-capacity.json
Aisha Patel: Post-incident planning: we need a short postmortem, include timeline, impact matrix, and concrete remediation work. Suggest 60m postmortem one business day out. Proposed owners + items below.
Priya Desai: Drafting timeline now. I can have an initial timeline and logs bundle by EOD.
Samir Rao: Note for remediation tracker: possible remediation ideas: a) enforce mixed instance types per pool, b) autoscaler hysteresis + better startup probes, c) regional throttling on canary model loads, d) billing alert for fallback cost.
Eli Nguyen: I'll help with telemetry dashboards: create a p99 latency vs provisioning heatmap and an autoscaler-event rate plot.
Nina Gomez: Customer comms draft: short note to impacted customers explaining transient capacity issue, mitigations, and credit offer. @Aisha will own sending.
Maya Cohen: Quick ops checklist added here: * isolate pool; * pin canary nodes; * enable conservative autoscale; * run model load test on pinned canary; * monitor errors for 60m.
Aisha Patel: Scheduling postmortem meeting: proposed Thu 2026-03-19 16:00 UTC (60m). @Priya you'll present timeline, @Samir infra/ops details, @Eli telemetry, @Nina customer impact. If that works I'll create calendar invite and link notes channel.
Priya Desai: Works for me.
Samir Rao: Works.
Eli Nguyen: Works.
Nina Gomez: Works — please include product+support.
incident-bot: Post-incident checklist created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1845012345
Aisha Patel: Recording action items (owner — ETA) :
- ACTION-1: "Investigate provider preemption signals and request provider-side logs" — Owner: Samir Rao — ETA: 2026-03-21
- ACTION-2: "Autoscaler config changes: add hysteresis and startup probe timeouts; set conservative defaults for gpu pools" — Owner: Priya Desai — ETA: 2026-03-18
- ACTION-3: "Create regional failover runbook w/ traffic-shifting playbook and cost guardrails" — Owner: Maya Cohen — ETA: 2026-03-22
- ACTION-4: "Telemetry work: p99 heatmap + autoscaler event rate dashboard + billing exposure metric" — Owner: Eli Nguyen — ETA: 2026-03-17
- ACTION-5: "Customer comms & credit calculation for impacted customers" — Owner: Aisha Patel — ETA: 2026-03-16
Priya Desai: I'll upload the logs bundle and attach initial RCA notes to the incident ticket by EOD.
Samir Rao: Leaving bridge now, monitoring logs. If anything regresses ping me directly.
Aisha Patel: Thanks everyone. I'll create the postmortem doc and add owners. Closing thread for live updates; please update incident ticket with progress on action items. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: NOTE — automated follow-up: scheduled reminder in 48h to @Priya for action-2 and to @Eli for action-4.
Priya Desai: Received reminder for follow-ups.
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — fallback stable and autoscaler conservative policy holding. Final note: total customer-visible error window ~16m.
